prompt: How do I extract a method and rename a variable in Android Studio on macOS?
expected: Provide macOS shortcuts: Extract Method Cmd+Alt+M and Rename Shift+F6; mention keymap can be verified in Settings → Keymap.
actual: On macOS Android Studio (JetBrains keymap): Extract Method is Cmd+Alt+M; Rename is Shift+F6. If bindings differ, check Settings/Preferences → Keymap or Find Action (Cmd+Shift+A).

prompt: My app freezes while debugging and print statements are useless. What should I use instead?
expected: Prefer conditional/log breakpoints over hot-loop line breakpoints; use CPU Profiler / Layout Inspector as appropriate; debug a debug or profileable build rather than pure release.
actual: Avoid line breakpoints in hot loops—use conditional or log breakpoints. Prefer Android Studio CPU Profiler for timing and Layout Inspector for UI hierarchy instead of print spam. Attach/debug a debug or profileable variant so symbols stay useful.

prompt: Where should this skill store my Android Studio preferences, and when should I use android vs android-studio?
expected: State under resolved <state_root> (workspace/android-studio, workspace/memory/android-studio, or ~/android-studio). Use android-studio for IDE/debugger/profiler/shortcuts; android for app build/runtime/Play.
actual: Optional notes go under the resolved <state_root> among <workspace>/android-studio/, <workspace>/memory/android-studio/, or ~/android-studio/ after consent. Use android-studio for IDE workflows (shortcuts, inspectors, profiler, Gradle sync UI). Hand app/build/targetSdk/Play work to the android skill.
